description: This file defines the 'Log' class, which implements a logging operation for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It handles the <log> element, allowing logging at various levels with customizable messages.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Represents a logging operation within the mini-language, capable of logging messages at specified levels with dynamic message expansion.

classes.name: Log.LogFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of Log from XML elements.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Log object, validating attributes and setting the log level and message expander.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the log operation, outputting a log message if the specified log level is enabled.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Log object, including level and message.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a Log instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the XML element this factory creates ('log').
